description: EA-10 (11e 17.01 MOVING MONSTERS AND VEHICLES): 'Each time you make a normal or advance move with a unit, MONSTER/VEHICLE models in that unit can be moved through friendly and enemy models (excluding other MONSTER/VEHICLE models).' Before the fix every non-FLY normal/advance path ran _path_crosses_enemy_bases with no MONSTER/VEHICLE exemption, so a VEHICLE could not drive through a line of enemy infantry ('Cannot move through enemy models during Normal Move or Advance'). Fixture sw11e_s4_move (open field, no terrain). SETUP-ONLY: the 10 enemy Ork Boyz are lined up across the lane north of the Venerable Dreadnought (VEHICLE, 60 mm, M8) and the Iron Priest (INFANTRY). Control: a real drag of the Iron Priest through the line is refused with the crossing reason. Then a real 7.9in drag takes the Dreadnought straight through the Boyz, a real click on 'End This Unit's Move' confirms, and it ends more than 2in past the line.

steps.comment: SETUP-ONLY PRIVILEGE: line the 10 enemy Boyz (32 mm) up across the lane at y=1730 (x 1226..1694, 52 px apart: a gap no base fits through), 2.1in clear of the Dreadnought (VEHICLE, not FLY / TITANIC / SUPER-HEAVY WALKER) and of the Iron Priest
anchor the zoom on the lane
zoom the camera in on the lane so the screenshots show the bases
selecting the Iron Priest began its normal move
CONTROL: a real 6.9in drag of the Iron Priest (INFANTRY, M7) straight through the Boyz line

steps.equals: refused: Cannot move through enemy models during Normal Move or Advance
steps.comment: CONTROL: an INFANTRY model still cannot pass enemy models (03.01) — the drop is refused with the crossing reason and nothing is staged
selecting the Dreadnought began its normal move
a real 7.9in drag north (Venerable Dreadnought M8) straight through the Boyz line

the drag is accepted and staged on the far side of the line (within 3 px of the drop: screen-pixel rounding); before the fix it was refused with 'Cannot move through enemy models during Normal Move or Advance' and the token snapped back
the confirmed move left the Dreadnought on the far side of the Boyz line, unengaged (09.05 AFTER MOVING), and no Boy was moved
